name: Facet
text: Make the interface dark-themed like Manus and Graphify. A dark background reduces eye strain during long sessions and makes interactive elements pop, improving clarity and liveliness. The trade-off is that some users prefer light themes for readability in bright environments, but we prioritize sustained focus over occasional glare.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes fail in high-glare environments—users squint at reflections on screens. A system-wide toggle (light/dark/auto) with a one-click switch settles it; we test glare in bright rooms, not just code.

name: Facet
text:
Add a dark theme as the default for EXCAVA, with a persistent one-click toggle in the top-right corner. The dark background sharpens focus and reduces glare in dim rooms, aligning with Manus and Graphify for consistency and speed. The trade-off is that users in bright, sunlit spaces may need to switch to light mode, but the toggle keeps the default fast and the switch trivial.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Default dark themes punish users in sunlit rooms—glare forces squinting, not focus. A system-wide toggle is table stakes, but we still need to test glare in *real* bright rooms, not just labs. The real risk isn’t consistency with Manus; it’s usability for the 30% of users who work near windows. Settle it with a glare test in a sunlit conference room—if 20% of testers switch to light mode, we ship a smarter default.

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Default EXCAVA to dark theme but expose a one-click system-wide light/dark/auto toggle in the top-right corner.

Result: A dark default that users can instantly override for glare, tested in real bright rooms. Owned by Facet (visualization-w1).
